cwg_reliefweb.page_title: Somalia Cash Working Group (Somalia Inter Agency Cash Working Group)
cwg_reliefweb.last_update_basis: Latest document posted on the page (GBV AoR guidance note on cash in GBV case management); no page updated stamp.
cwg_reliefweb.dashboard_name: Somalia CVA dashboard 2025 (also 2024; monthly cash and voucher mapping on HDX)
cwg_reliefweb.contacts_basis: Undated CALP CWG page whose co-lead email domains are wfp.org and concern.net; ReliefWeb page contacts list many organisations incl. Government of Somalia but no stated chair roles. Earlier project notes cite an OCHA non-programmatic co-chair (not verified here).
cwg_reliefweb.note: Meetings monthly; sub-national CWGs in seven areas and an FSP workstream. Dashboard figures not readable from page text; HDX visualisation opened shows only Aug 2020. Contacts tab lists a WFP chair only; the group's Nov 2024 minutes mention an OCHA co-chair, so the published structure may be incomplete.

cva_delivered_usd.note: OCHA Eastern Africa Q1 2025 overview: about US$36.3M CVA disbursed in Somalia in the quarter. WFP alone reports US$122.8M CBT in 2025 (annual country report), not a national total.

fsps.name: Hormuud Telecom (EVC Plus)
fsps.evidence: Hormuud/GSMA M4H (Jun 2023): EVC Plus underlies a Humanitarian Portal used by INGOs to deliver cash; Save the Children (USAID/FFP, 2017) used Hormuud and Golis mobile money.

fsps.name: Golis Telecom
fsps.evidence: CALP Nov 2017 case study: monthly cash transfers via mobile money with Golis and Hormuud in Bari, Nugaal and Hiran.
